posts.title: I thought capturing Linux kernel events would help agent monitoring a lot, but so far it doesn't seem to
posts.description: I replayed 800 AI agent runs inside a sandbox that records what the Linux kernel sees, and asked a small model to watch them with and without that evidence. A pre-registered test couldn't show it helped – here's what I learnt along the way.

posts.description: Benchmarking DeepSeek V4 Flash and GLM 5.3 Flash on a MacBook Pro – why parameter counts only predict the start, why the built-in draft model slows things down, and what it costs to keep your RAM back

posts.title: Feedback loop engineering
posts.description: Why the most important skill with AI coding agents isn't prompting or curating context – it's designing how they verify their own work
